data.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (panel finding during bug 374f fix, epic 588e)

#### Expected Behavior
verify-session-provenance.sh's A3b self-merge guard (line ~609) and review-coverage-lib.sh::rc_sha_is_reviewed's A3b guard are maintained as twins (the lib comment says "Mirrors the W4 fix in verify-session-provenance.sh"; DD6-style equivalence is the project convention). They should treat a rebase-merged PR's 1-parent merge_commit_sha tip identically.

#### Actual Behavior
Bug 374f narrowed review-coverage-lib.sh's A3b to exclude only genuine merge nodes (>=2 parents), so a 1-parent rebase/squash tip == merge_commit_sha keeps its covering-PR proof. verify-session-provenance.sh:609 still excludes unconditionally (`if pr.get('merge_commit_sha') == sha_under_review: continue`). The twins have diverged.

Live impact today: NONE — verify-session-provenance's unprovenanced path ROUTES TO RE-REVIEW (not block), and in this repo's ci.yml its rc 0/1/2/3 all proceed (only rc=4 fails). So it causes at most a redundant llm-review re-review of the version-bump tip (llm-review passed on PR #699). Risk: (a) consuming-project CI may wire verify-session-provenance as blocking -> same false-UNREVIEWED wedge 374f fixed; (b) inconsistent-twin maintenance hazard (a future maintainer may re-broaden the lib guard to "match").

#### Fix
Apply the same parent-count narrowing to verify-session-provenance.sh:609 (exclude only when sha_under_review has !=1 git parent, fail-closed on unknown), and add a DD6-style equivalence/divergence-guard test. Relates to bug 374f-f2c9-d084-466f.
data.title: [verify-session-provenance]: parallel A3b guard excludes 1-parent rebase tip unconditionally -> twin-diverges from review-coverage-lib after 374f narrowing
